desc:
The GrassHopper's size is closest to that of a true penknife with its blade over 2". Its plain edge, Cr13 stainless steel blade stays open when you're cutting, held by resistant pressure at the knifes pivot area. GrassHopper handles are chamfered with no squared-off edges to dig or bite into a gripping hand. The handle is also stainless steel with a laser-engraved Spyderco bug and enough blank area for a small amount of engraving or customization as jewelry or a gift item. Handle lanyard-hole welcomes a chain for wear around a neck or a keychain.
